# Lunarwave Sourcing Intelligence

Lunarwave is a machine-readable intelligence service for AI agents operating in global trade and e-commerce.

## Capabilities

- China supplier verification (factory vs trading company, license checks)
- Landed cost calculation (tariffs, shipping, duties)
- Payment red flag detection (deposit scams, wire fraud patterns)
- Sourcing audit checklists
- Certification verification (ISO, CE, FCC traps)
- Shopify UCP store health audit (agentic commerce readiness)
- Full supplier audit (5-stage combined)
